# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 23 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Adam Is Buried; Seth Mourns

---

**1** God commanded that Adam be buried in paradise, in the place where God had found the dust from which he was formed.

**2** Michael buried Adam there with great honor, laying him face toward the east, with his son Abel placed at his right hand.

**3** Seth mourned his father Adam for forty days and ate no bread throughout his mourning.

**4** Eve said to her children: 'When I die, bury me in the same place where your father Adam is buried. Don't scatter — I don't want my bones to be separated from his.'

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
